A Click'n'Load button now opens the extension's own popup instead of a window of its own, and one of those submissions could go missing entirely.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A Click'n'Load submission could vanish between the two halves of the interception, while the page was told it had worked.** The half that runs inside the page hands what it caught to the half that can reach the extension, and it addressed that handover to the page's own origin. Wherever that string is not what the receiving window actually matches — a local file, a sandboxed frame, a `data:` URL — the browser dropped the message, the links never arrived, and the button still reported success. Found by pressing a real button on a local test page and watching nothing happen.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Click'n'Load opens the extension's popup**, not a separate window. A window of its own arrives with a title bar, a taskbar entry and scrollbars, so a decision that takes one click looked like an application had started. The popup hangs off the toolbar button people already associate with this extension. Where a browser will not open a popup on its own, the old window is still the fallback.
- **The window title is just "KnightLoader"** everywhere. The options page still called itself "instances", which stopped being a thing it shows some versions ago.
- **"Accent colour" and "Colour palette" are set like every other row in that card**, and their info icons sit where the others do. They were smaller, greyer and had the icon jammed against the last letter, so two rows in one card read as two different kinds of setting.

## 📋 Notes

- Two info bubbles were saying things that had stopped being true: Click'n'Load described switching a feature on that is now on by default, and the theme bubble still offered a third option that no longer exists. A third bubble was removed outright rather than rewritten — it sat on a card with one control whose own label already explained it, and a bubble repeating the bubble beside it is the padding the rule exists to remove.
